canonicalS02Boundary.authority: local deterministic run cache plus server-verifiable settlement

adapterBoundary.role: canonical stateを表示専用に正規化するread-only adapter。P1はinterfaceを定義するだけで実装しない。
mustNot: canonical objectへUI convenience fieldを書き戻す
JavaScript Numberへunbounded decimalを変換する
missing valueをもっともらしいsampleで補う
paid/free ruby provenanceを曖昧に合算する
adapterBoundary.unknownPolicy: unknown、missing、conflictingはfail closed。critical値はunknown label、非critical値は非表示。直前のconfirmed値を使う場合はstale labelを付ける。

fixturePolicy.goldenMasterData: GM01からGM08内の数字と状態はレイアウト検証用の明示的DESIGN FIXTUREであり、実プレイヤーstate、server state、報酬付与を表さない。
fixturePolicy.testRule: P2/P3 runtime buildはfixture namespaceがproduction bundleへ入るとfailする。

floor.rule: 上限を示す語を付けず、100Fを最終階と表現しない。

amount.input: canonical decimal string or versioned arbitrary-precision representation
amount.output: canonical display abbreviation policy when available
amount.rule: policy不在時にK/M/Bへ独自変換しない。

hp.output: clamped visual ratio plus exact text
hp.rule: max unknown or non-positiveはratioを表示せず、値確認中とする。

duration.input: non-negative integer seconds from canonical elapsed source
duration.output: 日・時間・分、必要時だけ秒
duration.rule: client wall clock差分だけでoffline elapsedを確定しない。

stateLabel.rule: 未知enumは推測せず不明または再確認表示。

bindings.display: DESIGN REVIEW / S02 GOLDEN MASTER / NOT RUNTIME
bindings.fallback: missing is review-page failure

bindings.display: stateに応じたscreen、sheet、error。enum自体を通常時に露出しない。
bindings.fallback: RETRYABLE_ERROR presentation; no combat interaction

bindings.authority: local deterministic run cache, server-verifiable for progression
bindings.type: positive normalized decimal string or canonical floor ID
bindings.display: floor formatter
bindings.fallback: 階数確認中; never show 0 or invented floor

bindings.display: approved localized enemy class/name only
bindings.fallback: 敵情報確認中 with neutral silhouette; never substitute another enemy

bindings.display: one explicit objective such as 撃破 current/required; kind must be canonical
bindings.fallback: 目標確認中; hide progress ratio
bindings.antiFake: UI does not infer kill need from visual enemy count

bindings.display: enemy HP bar and exact text when width permits
bindings.fallback: HP確認中; indeterminate track; never full bar

visibleIn: GM06 if scenario contains enemy counterattack
bindings.source: combat telegraph event: enemyEntityId, actionKind, target, commitTick, cancelState
bindings.display: body pose plus shape and label; countdown only when commit timing is real
bindings.fallback: no countdown; clear telegraph on missing/cancel

bindings.authority: local deterministic run control with persisted policy as defined later
bindings.type: closed enum; not a generic boolean until schema is fixed
bindings.display: AUTO + explicit state label
bindings.fallback: 状態確認中; no visual toggle mutation
bindings.antiFake: not presented as active skill or damage command

bindings.authority: server ownership/formation plus server-verifiable run state
bindings.display: approved portrait、name、slot order、explicit participation state
bindings.fallback: slot skeleton with 読込中; never show an unowned character portrait as fielded

visibleIn: all normal screens as compact label
bindings.source: derived only from party4 slot, ownership eligibility and active field entity linkage
bindings.authority: server ownership and formation; local field entity is run cache

closedStates.field: owned=true AND slot assignment exists AND active fieldEntityId references this character; label 戦場参加中
closedStates.ownedReserve: owned=true AND no active field entity; label 所有済み
closedStates.available: owned=false AND deterministic acquisition eligibility is explicitly eligible; label 加入可能
closedStates.locked: owned=false AND eligibility is locked with known requirement; label 未解放
closedStates.unknown: conflict or missing source; label 状態確認中

bindings.display: label + frame shape + icon/stripe; color only is forbidden
bindings.fallback: unknown; interaction disabled
bindings.antiFake: available is never field or owned; locked portrait treatment never implies battle participation

visibleIn: battlefield labels or character cards when canonical state exists
bindings.display: compact ally HP; exact text in detail surface only
bindings.fallback: hide fill and show 状態確認中; never assume full health

bindings.source: S02.party4[].fieldEntity snapshot: position, facing, animationState, targetEntityId
bindings.display: approved cat asset attached by canonical characterId
bindings.fallback: loading composition; do not substitute another cat
bindings.antiFake: only an active field entity may appear as fighting

bindings.display: animation contract timeline
bindings.fallback: idle/walk only; no visual attack
bindings.antiFake: CSS timer alone cannot create attack

bindings.source: combat damage applied event with eventId, source, target, amountDecimal, critical, simulationTick
bindings.display: exact text damage number, HP update, hit reaction
bindings.fallback: no number and no hit effect
bindings.antiFake: visual layer never calculates or samples damage

bindings.source: combat entity defeated event with eventId and entityId
bindings.display: defeat clip and encounter progress change
bindings.fallback: entity remains in last valid non-defeat state
bindings.antiFake: visual HP ratio alone does not mint defeat

bindings.source: reward event or settlement result: eventId, settlementId, status, currencyCanonicalId, amountDecimal
bindings.canonicalRoot: S02.settlementStatus and server-owned permanent reward settlement
bindings.authority: server-verifiable settlement for permanent reward; local provisional run result when explicitly marked
bindings.display: source cue + amount + 見込み/照合中/確定 label
bindings.fallback: 報酬を表示しない; error state may say 報酬を再確認
bindings.antiFake: no random coin amount, no animation-generated wallet update, no confirmed label before settlement

bindings.source: wallet.coin.run canonical decimal value with stateVersion
bindings.display: coin icon + exact formatted amount; pending delta separately labeled
bindings.fallback: chip hidden or 残高確認中; never show zero as fallback
bindings.antiFake: reward feedback does not directly mutate the displayed wallet

bindings.display: not displayed on S02 P1 Golden Master; S11 owns detail
bindings.fallback: none
bindings.antiFake: no aggregate ruby chip without a canonical disclosure-preserving display policy

bindings.source: S02.temporarySupport: supportId, state, arrivalTick, effect summary, remaining if canonical
bindings.authority: local run cache with server-verifiable eligibility where required
bindings.display: 支援名、到着/発動/終了state、real effect summary
bindings.fallback: support strip hidden; no invented countdown
bindings.antiFake: temporary support never consumes a party4 slot and never appears as a permanent owned cat

bindings.source: S05 projectedCombatSupport or delivery event snapshot passed into S02
bindings.authority: server profile configuration plus local forecast
bindings.display: battle impact summary or real next arrival; details navigate to S05
bindings.fallback: 支援詳細を非表示; neutral S05 navigation may remain if route available
bindings.antiFake: no sale price, fake delivery timer, unconfigured buff, or shop management panel on S02

bindings.authority: reconciliation input; not client wall clock alone
bindings.display: duration formatter and cap disclosure when applicable
bindings.fallback: 経過時間確認中
bindings.antiFake: do not claim an exact duration from an untrusted local timestamp

bindings.source: S02.offlineCatchup.status and progress only if determinate
bindings.display: 照合中、暫定、確定、再確認のexplicit label
bindings.fallback: indeterminate labeled progress; never fake percent

visibleIn: GM07 after a provisional or confirmed result exists
bindings.canonicalRoot: offlineCatchup and server-owned permanent reward settlement
bindings.authority: provisional local calculation or server settlement according to row status
bindings.display: each amount carries 見込み or 確定; confirmed result separated visually
bindings.fallback: amount rows hidden; outcome state retained
bindings.antiFake: no server完了、no confirmed reward、no wallet delta until actual state

bindings.display: pending/confirmed/retry/error label and permitted action
bindings.fallback: 状態確認中; reward and floor transition remain unconfirmed

visibleIn: only when candidate/pending state is relevant
bindings.display: 記録候補 or 記録確定 with exact floor; ordinary S02 may omit
bindings.fallback: hidden; never claim new record

bindings.source: canonical screen route availability plus current uiState
bindings.canonicalRoot: SCREEN_STATE_REGISTRY screen ownership and future routing contract
bindings.display: 編成、塔、商会などのreal destination only; action name must describe navigation
bindings.fallback: disabled with 読込中 or hidden
bindings.antiFake: no active skill, no direct damage button, no route that is not implemented

bindings.source: future canonical route registry and per-route availability
bindings.display: five destinations with visible labels and current S02 selection
bindings.fallback: known routes only; unavailable route disabled with reason

bindings.source: S02 error domain, stable error code, retry capability, lastConfirmedStateVersion
bindings.display: plain-language status、retained confirmed values、safe retry or support path
bindings.fallback: 一般的な再確認表示; destructive actionなし
bindings.antiFake: no server status claim from HTTP success alone

settlementDecisionTable.display: 見込み amount; no wallet destination animation
照合中 amount; repeat action suppressed
確定 amount; one deduplicated reward feedback
再確認; no confirmed wallet mutation

deduplication.rule: rerender、resume、reconnectで同一confirmed eventのeffectやtoastを再生しない。

loadingAndError.composition: battle artを偽stateで埋めず、stable skeletonとDESIGN/LOADING labelを使用
loadingAndError.staleState: last confirmed snapshotを表示する場合は更新待ち labelとversionを保持
loadingAndError.retry: idempotent read/reconciliationだけ。reward claimやwallet operationはcanonical operation contractへ委譲。

p2P3ImplementationTests: floorId is rendered from a decimal string without precision loss
party field, owned, available and locked states match the decision table
unowned or locked character never appears as fighting
attack effect is absent without attack event
damage text is absent without damage event
defeat and reward are absent without their events
provisional reward never changes confirmed wallet presentation
confirmed reward is deduplicated after rerender and reconnect
offline percent is absent when progress is indeterminate
ruby aggregate is absent on S02 until provenance-safe policy exists
missing shop projection hides effect rather than inventing a buff
error retains last confirmed data with an explicit stale label
review fixtures are excluded from runtime bundle
